probes.name: superpowers at project scope, arm A
probes.how: one turn; .claude/settings.json enables superpowers@claude-plugins-official and declares its marketplace; launcher reads project,local settings only
probes.seen: init plugins list superpowers 7.0.0 and Claude Code built-ins only (the user's other plugin absent); one SessionStart context beginning 'You have superpowers'; modelUsage claude-sonnet-5-5 only

probes.name: superpowers plus ElevenPowers, arm B
probes.how: as arm A, plus core.hosts.setup.install and Config(profile='guide'); ElevenPowers writes settings.local.json and leaves the project file alone
probes.seen: superpowers 7.0.0 in init plugins; two SessionStart contexts, the second beginning 'ElevenPowers active (profile: guide)'; modelUsage claude-sonnet-5-5 only

probes.name: Skill tool and resume, arm B
probes.how: two turns with Skill added to --tools, --session-id then --resume
probes.seen: the held-out launcher's tool list has no Skill tool, so superpowers' 37 skills were listed but could not be invoked; with Skill added, superpowers:verification-before-completion loaded. On resume only ElevenPowers' SessionStart hook fires (superpowers' matcher excludes resume). total_cost_usd and modelUsage are cumulative over the session

probes.name: user CLAUDE.md, before the fix
probes.how: one turn asking which CLAUDE.md files the agent was given
probes.seen: named C:\Users\<user>\.claude\CLAUDE.md: --setting-sources does not keep the user's own instructions out

probes.name: user CLAUDE.md, excluded
probes.how: same question with claudeMdExcludes in project settings, then in --settings, then neither, on a project whose CLAUDE.md holds a codeword
probes.seen: with the exclusion (either place): user file absent, project codeword present, superpowers still loaded; without it: user file present

verdict: qualified, with two harness changes made before any paid stage: Skill is allowed in both arms (Agent stays denied, as in every earlier controller), and the user's CLAUDE.md is excluded from every subscription run
